ECCO Intelligence - Ghost diagnostics (SIMULATION, read-only)
SIMULATION, read-only. Intelligence controlled nothing; the existing schedule did what it did. The advice run
is arithmetic on recorded hourly data. Evidence for the owner, never a decision.
Period 2030-01-14 00:00 to 2030-01-17 00:00 (72 h). Tariff: import VERIFIED_FROM_INTEGRATION, export NOT_VERIFIED
Advice logged in the period: 3; followed in the simulation 3; not followed: none
EXISTING SCHEDULE = what the battery really did.  INTELLIGENCE ADVICE = the same flows with the logged advice
applied (simulated).

  Money (pence, before wear; + = advice ahead):

  ADVICE EFFECT -98.0 p; noise +/-11.9 p (efficiency 6.6 + stock rules 5.3 + baseline 0.0; floor 0.5)
  VERDICT: ADVICE_BEHIND_BEYOND_NOISE (advice behind, beyond the noise)
  SOC %: minimum existing 40.0, advice 40.0 (+0.0); end of the last day existing 40.0, advice 40.0 (+0.0)
         closing stored energy, advice minus existing: +0.00 kWh
  RESERVE 40.0 %: margin to it: existing +0.0, advice +0.0; VERDICT NO_BREACH
           advice below the reserve: 0 slot(s) on 0 day(s); at efficiency -3/+3 points: 0/0
           existing schedule below the reserve: 0 slot(s)
  Days: 0 ahead beyond noise, 2 behind beyond noise, 1 within noise, 0 with no advice effect

Data: 72 usable of 72 hours in the window; 0 repaired/flagged; flags: OPENING_STOCK_UNPRICED, WEAR_UNKNOWN
  note: EXPORT_TARIFF_NOT_VERIFIED: export income counted as 0 (understates a ghost that exports)
Closing stock: closing stock difference valued two ways, the one less favourable to the ghost used: (a) each
  run's mixed-tank cost basis; (b) deliverable kWh at the period's mean import price
Limits:
  - hourly data: SOC is an hourly mean and advice windows snap to whole hours
  - only advice that was actually logged is simulated; dump advice has no logged window and is not simulated
  - spilled PV is unknown (taken as 0); the real battery's own limits are replayed as recorded
  - money needs a verified import rate table covering the period: it covers only the days the tariff
    integration publishes, so a money period can be much shorter than the history
  - a simulation of one house over a short period: it is evidence, not proof, and decides nothing
Read-only simulation. Nothing was changed, deployed or controlled.
